title: Fix G2: the gate summary tells the truth and an unattended done needs a reason
description: Fix G2: the gate summary tells the truth and an unattended done needs a reason
acceptance_criteria: The gate summary counts a passing observation with no case, shows uncommitted work as git diff <base> and counts a session with no base from the first commit; doctor's unfinished_archive fix names the journal post and finishes no archive while it is uncommitted; without SpecSync, stage advance says no human decision is recorded for plan or accept, and --to across them refuses as refused:no-human-decision unless --reason is given, which lands in the Timeline.

answers.constraints: cli and history lessons apply: #390 is Leif's decision B; the new refusal names its way out and gets the tester's real-repository run (rule 3); every new free-text value (--reason) goes through the leak check with a leak-sample test
